description: This file is a server-side route handler in a SvelteKit project, specifically for listing, creating, updating, and handling estimates in a CRM/invoicing context. It includes data fetching, transformation, and action methods for CRUD and related operations on estimates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes estimates data, along with related accounts, contacts, and templates, then prepares data for frontend rendering.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new estimate with data from the submitted form.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing estimate identified by estimateId with submitted form data.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes an existing estimate specified by estimateId.

methods.name: actions.send
methods.description: Sends an estimate via email or notification (implemented via API call).

methods.name: actions.convert
methods.description: Converts an estimate into an invoice using API endpoint.

methods.name: actions.accept
methods.description: Marks an estimate as accepted by updating its status.

methods.name: actions.decline
methods.description: Marks an estimate as declined by updating its status.
